parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 10. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: Path
parameters.description: The parameter path. The path must be fewer than 200 characters. For example, for the parameter /secretParameter/mySecretParameter, the path is /secretParameter.

parameters.name: Recursive
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to recursively query the path. For example, given the parameters /secretParameter/mySecretParameter and /secretParameter/secretParameter1/mySecretParameter, valid values:
- true: Both /secretParameter/mySecretParameter and /secretParameter/secretParameter1/mySecretParameter are returned.
- false: Only /secretParameter/mySecretParameter is returned.

parameters.name: WithDecryption
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to decrypt the parameter value.
Valid values:
- true
- false (default)
